description: This file defines the class `SugarThemeRegistry`, which manages themes within the SuiteCRM system. It provides methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and configuring themes, as well as handling theme registry building and querying available themes.

classes.name: SugarThemeRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing theme registration, retrieval, and configuration within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new theme to the registry after validating its compatibility with the current SugarCRM version.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a theme from the registry based on its name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a theme object from the registry by name.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current active theme object.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a theme with the given name exists in the registry.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the current theme by name.

methods.name: buildRegistry
methods.description: Builds the theme registry by scanning theme directories and loading theme definitions.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the default theme, prioritizing the 'Sugar' theme if available.

methods.name: availableThemes
methods.description: Returns an array of themes available for selection, excluding disabled ones.

methods.name: unAvailableThemes
methods.description: Returns themes that are disabled or unavailable.

methods.name: allThemes
methods.description: Returns all themes found in the installation.

methods.name: allThemesDefs
methods.description: Returns definitions of all themes, including their configuration status.

methods.name: getThemeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options for a specified theme.

methods.name: getSubThemes
methods.description: Retrieves available sub-themes options for the current theme.

methods.name: getSubThemeDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default sub-theme setting for the current theme.
